release_gate: All 20 missions have unique playable layouts, objectives, enemy placement and secrets
All boss encounters have distinct mechanics and verified phase transitions
All five weapons have functional combat behavior, balancing and dedicated animation sets
Skill upgrades change actual gameplay values or unlock abilities
Save/load survives app restart and handles invalid or old save data
Touch controls support simultaneous inputs and are tested on target Android devices
APK is exported and launched on a real Android device
Campaign completion, ending and replay flow are verified
